new_processes.name: Audit support request

new_processes.definition: Ordering phones, headsets and facility repairs for the trading group.

new_processes.name: Deal entry correction
new_processes.definition: Zeroing out duplicate or wrong deals and telling the affected party about the revenue effect.

new_processes.name: FSP rollout updates
new_processes.definition: Status updates and training plans for the FSP system parallel test and go-live.

new_processes.name: Project status report
new_processes.definition: Weekly distribution of the project status report to a list of recipients.

new_processes.definition: Arranging presentations and preparation material for the real-time trading group.

new_processes.definition: Sharing OASIS sites, transmission paths and procedures with the real-time traders.

new_processes.name: Prior month adjustment review
new_processes.definition: Reviewing prior month adjustment sheets with the risk group and chasing unexplained revenue or cost differences.
